decision_basis: Decisions are classified as: current_canon_reuse (existing owner behavior extended), accepted_discussion (user-approved direction from the packet), or packet_engineering_resolution (within-scope design choice recorded per the packet's authority to resolve ordinary engineering details). Hard authority boundaries were not changed by any tuning decision.

decisions.decision: Create Plans/Working_Notebook.md as the new semantic owner with New Plan Authoring Profile and PlanUnit prefix WN-001..WN-020.
decisions.reason: Equivalence search over live Plans/*.md (notebook/working notes/scratchpad/resume capsule) found no existing owner; nearest neighbors (ARC-019 attempt journal, ARC-020 parent summary, AMS gists, OSI structured-attempt-handoff, BSD held findings) are deliberately scoped away from durable PM working notes. WN- prefix verified collision-free.
decisions.acceptance_effect: WNC-S03 single-owner closure; consumers reference rather than duplicate.

decisions.decision: Tool names notebook_search, notebook_read, notebook_write, notebook_supersede, fresh_context_request; exact history read named chatread alongside chatsearch/logsearch/logread.
decisions.reason: chatread follows the existing logread exact-read pattern (event_id/blob_ref) and the chat* family prefix; notebook_* is self-descriptive and collision-free. Contracts registered in Tools.md (T-183/184); no handlers claimed.
decisions.acceptance_effect: WNC-N09/H01 concrete names; WN-020 error mapping stable.

decisions.decision: Transition record ContextWindowTransition (cwt_) with lifecycle requested→preparing→checkpointed→admitted→activated→recovered_resumed plus terminal deferred/denied/failed/cancelled; checkpoint id nbc_; notebook nb_; entry wne_.
decisions.basis: packet_engineering_resolution (contract §6 state table mapped 1:1) into Prompt_Pipeline (policy) + storage registry (record)
decisions.reason: Contract requires exactly these distinctions and failure edges; ownersPrompt_Pipeline/Shared_Integration_Runtime already own admission/recovery machinery, so no new state-machine owner is created.
decisions.acceptance_effect: WNC-C05 closed schema; fixtures validate all edges.

decisions.decision: Fresh-window policy lives in Prompt_Pipeline (PP-084..090); runtime reconciliation in Shared_Integration_Runtime (SIR-036/037); Working_Notebook owns only checkpoint content.
decisions.reason: Packet semantic allocation assigns budget/selection/reconstruction/fresh-window policy to Prompt Pipeline and durable runtime to Shared Integration Runtime.

decisions.decision: Checkpoint reserve reuses the existing contingency bucket (5% allocation target) and model-owned 70/85 pressure thresholds; no second pool.
decisions.reason: Packet guardrail forbids stacking another unconditional percentage; Prompt_Pipeline §2.2 and Models_System §3.3.3 already define these.

decisions.decision: Packet starting defaults adopted unchanged: capsule 512 tokens/2 KiB; capsule+entries 1,024 tokens/4 KiB; search 5/10 hits, 512 B snippets, 8 KiB response; read 8 KiB default/32 KiB hard; entry body 64 KiB; growth review 64 entries/1 MiB; one automatic retry.
decisions.reason: Current owners had no conflicting values; adopting them avoids unjustified tuning. Recorded as ceilings subject to admission, never reservations.
decisions.acceptance_effect: All bounds are encoded in schema and fixtures.

decisions.decision: Four Project-scoped settings memory.notebook.auto-capture|resume-capsule|capsule-budget-tokens|injection-budget-tokens registered as static inventory registrations under the existing memory category.
decisions.reason: The inventory category list is closed (12 categories); memory is the continuity-adjacent category. Static inventory registration asserts data contract, not pane rendering, per the established Settings_System pattern.
decisions.acceptance_effect: WNC-X04 closure with no global settings and no schema change.

decisions.decision: Notebook event families documented as candidate_not_registered with planned payload minima in Working_Notebook.md §3; no event_family_registry.json rows added at Plans stage.
decisions.reason: The event registry admits only schema-backed families (payload schemas under Plans/event_payloads/, retention assignment, currentness evidence); adding rows without them would create quarantined unknown families and require governance regeneration mid-authoring. Truthful candidate disposition is the required deliverable (WNC-X05 dispositions).
decisions.acceptance_effect: No unregistered event is presented as registered; runtime wave owns registration.

decisions.decision: Four storage_value_registry families with status deferred_not_build_blocking, value schemas in working_notebook_contracts.schema.json; retention RP-AUTHORITY-INDEFINITE (records/checkpoints) and RP-RUNTIME-365D (transition records).
decisions.reason: The registry's deferred status is the established pre-materialization pattern (run_record_legacy_baseline precedent); retention reuses existing policies rather than inventing new ones. Registry count pins updated as narrowly necessary spec tooling.

decisions.decision: Catalog rows cmd.chat.open_working_notebook, cmd.chat.request_fresh_context, cmd.orchestrator.open_notebook with candidate_not_registered disposition; no Wiring_Matrix.production.json rows; fail-closed command_not_registered until wired.
decisions.reason: Production wiring rows would fabricate registration; catalog rows already carry truthful no-event-family dispositions (cmd.chat.compact_context precedent).

decisions.decision: Exactly one range convention per request: unicode_char_offsets or utf8_byte_offsets, never mixed.
decisions.reason: Single unambiguous convention with explicit naming; encoded in schema enum and negative fixture.

decisions.decision: Extend AMS claims with evidence_support/support_scope/currentness rather than creating a new verification authority; migrated weakly-Verified gists reassessed at next verification evaluation.
decisions.reason: WNC-M02 requires strengthening Verified semantics; assistant-memory-subsystem owns verification, so the extension lands there (AMS-044..046).
decisions.acceptance_effect: No fake entailment proof; old labels not grandfathered.

decisions.decision: Durable notebook actions unavailable with typed reason without a valid Project binding; no alternate no-Project scope invented.
decisions.basis: packet_engineering_resolution (defaults row 'No Project') + Settings_System Project-scoping canon
decisions.reason: Current thread owner has no explicit supported no-Project durable scope; ordinary chat remains usable.

decisions.decision: Spec Lock refresh, shard regeneration, plan-index regeneration, and auto-decision rows deferred to the explicit seal phase after semantic closure, per Decision_Policy §5.
decisions.reason: AGENTS.md forbids governance updates during ordinary authoring; seal is separate and serial.
